reviews.visual_review: One adult human vampire hunter. Dark wavy hair, open black leather jacket, burgundy top, black trousers/boots and one wooden stake in her own right hand. Left hand empty; no thigh holster or second weapon in g2. Arms are separate from torso and both feet planted. g2 corrects the visible base top from g1. No text, logo, team band or extra anatomy.
limits: Top of hair is around 2% of image height, below the requested minimum 4% margin; base bottom is around 98%, not requested 93%. These are visual estimates, not pixel segmentation measurements.
This has no canonical asset-card registration or independent formal 1a acceptance. No 3D/rig/UE readiness claim.
